title: Millhaven Living - Work, Friends and Visitors
objective: Restore the well, mill and working wagon using the real crew, tools and supplies. Meet accepted orders and maintain configured reserves without unnecessary production. Eat breakfast after waking and supper at 19:00 at the tavern, paying the configured price. Use interests, personal projects, music and optional quests during genuinely free time. Respond to locally discovered events and trade with visitors only when affordable and useful. Complete assigned daily town maintenance at its real sites; unfinished jobs carry forward at midnight. Use free workday time for occupational research; verified discoveries unlock real recipes and useful goods. Keep iron renewable: mine ore, haul it and smelt it with real logs, or buy the daily trader's finite consignment in person. Travel home by bedtime, sleep adequately, stop routes and put the real horse away. Leisure, sidequests, and visitor departures are not mandatory resident victory conditions. Care daily for the physical farm cow and twelve hens using real balanced feed, well water and clean housing. Collect milk/eggs only for actual funded demand. Recycle only fresh plant surplus as chicken supplements; spoiled food becomes real compost material, never animal feed.
opening_narrative: Millhaven is waking to a day of work and ordinary village life. Breakfast follows each villager's wake time; supper is at 19:00. Suppliers produce against real demand and small reserves. Buyers may post one funded supply request at the physical square board or write at the supplier's physical workplace inbox. Only actual readers or listeners learn it; replies and project appointments need real channels. Continue useful work while waiting. Meals cost two coins. Elsie coordinates the inn, Iona is writing her herbal book, and interested villagers can rehearse or play music together. Hobbies and sidequests are optional. Passing visitors and minor events may change plans, but everyone still needs time to eat, care for the horse, travel home and sleep.
